prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. MIC Rhema level 1 Caminhante avatar frame. Reference is STYLE QUALITY ONLY, not its green/gold motif. Make the simplest entry-level companion: polished silver and cool blue-gray metal #90A4AE circular ring, two small metallic leaf pairs along each lower side, a modest four-point silver medallion centered at bottom, small round silver rivet at top. Elegant restrained entry-level design, not a grand legendary badge. Premium dimensional 3D edges and fine brushed metal detail. Circular empty opening exactly centered and about 58 percent canvas diameter, continuous inner rim, no ornament inside central face area. Whole frame completely inside square with 8 percent free margin including symbols. 1024x1024 final asset. No portrait, text, numbers, watermark or scenery. Backdrop and central opening are a uniform flat PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF chroma key for local transparency finishing; no checkerboard and absolutely no magenta reflected onto the silver metal. Keep material colors silver/blue-gray only.

Use case: stylized-concept. MIC Rhema level 2 Semeador circular avatar frame. Use the reference's simple dimensional 3D ring structure and quality, preserving the early-level restrained design. Change palette to fresh green #66BB6A enamel with delicate silver edges. Add a small two-leaf green seedling at top rim, three small paired green metallic leaves along each lower side, modest four-point green/silver medallion at bottom. Keep a CLOSED continuous circular inner ring, empty opening centered diameter about 58 percent canvas. All symbols entirely at rim, no protrusions into face area. Complete uncropped ring and leaf tips, 8 percent blank margin. Crisp 1024x1024 quality with fine dimensional material shading. No portrait, lettering, numbers, scenery or watermark. Uniform flat solid PURE #FF00FF MAGENTA in background AND empty central hole for transparency finishing, no checkerboard or magenta reflections on frame. Match reference family, simple before the ornate high levels.

Use case: stylized-concept. MIC Rhema level 3 Discípulo avatar frame. Reference is the early-level family shape and polished 3D material quality. Closed circular ring in vivid sky-blue #42A5F5 enamel and polished silver edges. A modest SIX-POINT blue metallic star at top rim, four small blue/silver laurel leaves each lower side, small four-point blue/silver bottom medallion. Clearly a blue star emblem, more developed than entry-level but restrained. Empty circular opening exactly centered diameter 58 percent canvas. No symbols intrude into the central face area. Fully complete frame and tips inside 8 percent blank margin. Sharp dimensional 3D render at 1024x1024. No portrait, text, number, watermark or scenery. Flat solid pure #FF00FF magenta key in BOTH outside and central hole, no checkerboard and no magenta reflections on silver/blue object.

Use case: stylized-concept. MIC Rhema level 4 Perseverante avatar frame. Use reference early-level ring family and polished dimensional 3D quality. Preserve understated progressive level design. Empty circular opening exactly centered, about 58 percent canvas diameter, no ornament projecting into central face area. Whole ring and tips fully contained with 8 percent blank margin. Crisp 1024x1024 dimensional 3D detail. No portrait, text, watermark or scenery. Flat PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF background and central opening for chroma key, no checkerboard or colored reflection on frame.

Use case: stylized-concept. MIC Rhema level 5 Estudante Rhema avatar frame. Early-level scholarly emblem, no royal crown or lions. Premium crisp dimensional 3D metal and fine etched page details, 1024x1024. Empty circular avatar opening exactly centered about 58 percent diameter, no ornament entering central face area. Complete book, ring and all tips inside canvas with 8 percent free margin. No portrait, text, numbers, watermark or background scenery. Outside AND central hole uniformly flat pure #FF00FF magenta chroma key, no checkerboard, no pink reflections or haze.
